description: Spring Boot configuration class for the Hono HTTP adapter, defining beans, configuration properties, and customization methods for the adapter.

classes.name: Config
classes.description: Spring Boot configuration class for the HTTP adapter, extending AbstractAdapterConfig and defining beans and configuration methods.

methods.name: vertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter
methods.description: Creates and returns a new instance of VertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter with prototype scope.

methods.name: customizeDownstreamSenderFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides method to set default name for downstream sender if not set.

methods.name: customizeRegistrationClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides method to set default name for registration client if not set.

methods.name: customizeCredentialsClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides method to set default name for credentials client if not set.

methods.name: customizeTenantClientFactoryConfig
methods.description: Overrides method to set default name for tenant client if not set.

methods.name: adapterProperties
methods.description: Provides configuration properties for the HTTP adapter, mapped to 'hono.http' prefix.

methods.name: commonTags
methods.description: Creates a MeterRegistryCustomizer bean that adds common tags for metrics, specifically for the HTTP protocol adapter.

methods.name: serviceFactory
methods.description: Creates a factory bean for producing instances of VertxBasedHttpProtocolAdapter.
